show.description: Road to Regret is a passionate romantic drama of betrayal, sacrifice, and unexpected love. Esha, a spoiled heiress, gets trapped in a toxic engagement with cunning Rohit, while her father’s failing health forces her into a sudden marriage with the loyal Aditya Suri. Bound by duty but torn between pride, manipulation, and growing emotions, Esha must decide whether love can truly rise from regret—or if it’s already too late.
